extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the Sewanee Writers' Conference; writers seeking information about admission, fellowships, and scholarships
extracted.subtask_description: Information and eligibility criteria for admission, fellowships, and scholarships to the Sewanee Writers' Conference, and what participants can expect during the conference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competitive admission via formal application
rubrics_metrics.description: Admission to the conference is competitive and is decided through a formal application process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applicants who are accepted to the conference have a portion of their expenses underwritten by the estate of Tennessee Williams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship eligibility — published full-length book
rubrics_metrics.description: Poets, non-fiction, and fiction writers who have published at least one full-length book, whether through a legitimate small press or a major publishing house, are eligible to apply for a limited number of fellowships to cover all tuition, room, and board for the conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowships are limited in number and, for accepted applicants, are underwritten by the estate of Tennessee Williams; publication may be with a small press or major house but must be a full-length book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholarship eligibility — periodical publication record
rubrics_metrics.description: Poets, non-fiction, and fiction writers with a record of publication in periodicals are eligible to apply for scholarships (also limited in number) to cover conference tuition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scholarships are limited in number; the relevant publication credential is a record of periodical publication rather than a full-length book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Playwright award eligibility — production history
rubrics_metrics.description: Playwrights are eligible for fellowships and scholarships if their work has seen production, either professional or amateur.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Production (professional or amateur) serves as the qualifying credential for playwrights to apply for the same limited awards available to poets/fiction/nonfiction writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: General admission does not require publication or production
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication or production is not required for general admission to the conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While fellowships and scholarships have publication/production eligibility criteria, applicants may still be admitted to the conference without having published or produced work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference programming and participant expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: The conference takes place over twelve days, during which participants attend writing workshops, readings, panel presentations, lectures on the craft of poetry, fiction, and playwriting, and numerous social gatherings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted participants should expect an intensive twelve-day program combining craft instruction (workshops, lectures, panels) and community-building events (readings, social gatherings).
